hero.role: Product management and business development, grounded in design thinking and operations.
hero.sub: I take health-tech and AI products from idea to tested prototype and build the business case around them.
credentials: MS candidate, USC Iovine and Young Academy

roles.label: Product management
roles.summary: I take products from an idea to a tested prototype. On Validex I ran product solo: shaped the idea, built the prototype, sized the market, wrote user personas and ran validation tests, reaching a 3.4% traffic-conversion rate from more than 2,000 impressions. I designed and built Symptom Visualizer and Market Distance Matrix end to end in TypeScript and React, with unit and browser tests behind both. As Product Leader at a stealth AI startup, I moved the product from prototype to investor readiness.

roles.label: Design thinking
roles.summary: I start with the people who will use the thing. I led UI/UX research for the USC Mann website across 19 institutional and corporate benchmark reports, ran playtests with six participants at Game Night Studios, and tested Validex with real people through social media and digital interviews. Then I turn the research into design: an interactive body map where every effect traces back to its FDA label, and science lessons taught in two languages with digital content built for remote classes.

roles.label: Operations and process improvement
roles.summary: My operations grounding is GMP manufacturing. At Serum Institute of India I ran protein-quantification tests at 99.4% accuracy and worked across quality assurance, upstream and downstream teams. At Eisen Pharmaceutical I QA-tested 8–10 drug batches and streamlined dispensing, compounding and packaging. I bring the same discipline to teams outside the plant: standardized communication templates at USC Mann, progress trackers and delivery timelines for a four-person startup team, and statistical tests of a machine-learning model’s predictive accuracy on the HPE and Corporate Gurukul capstone.

roles.label: Business development
roles.summary: I build the case for a venture and the network around it. For Everplate I modeled cash flow and valuation and built a funding strategy projected to reach break-even within eight quarters. At a stealth AI startup I managed the full BD pipeline and produced five pitch decks and investor documents. I wrote the documents guiding Game Night Studios from ideation to go-to-market strategy, helped grow Nexus Group USC to more than 40 members, and built Market Distance Matrix to measure how close competitors sit to a product.
